videos.caption: 💔 Etsy Shop Announcement Video 😭 • • I put on my story the other day that I would be making an announcement regarding my Etsy shop and here it is. Etsy has decided to make a new policy that would make it so that they could take any listing image up on their page (starting on Dec. 16th) and take it to train AI. I think it’s absolutely ridiculous that Etsy is doing this, especially since SO many artists use their site to host their shop. Ever since I heard the news, I knew I had to make the unfortunate decision to close my shop (which sucks because I haven’t even had it open for a year yet!). If anyone has any suggestions for where to host my shop, I would super appreciate it! And if you could help support me and my shop that would be super appreciated as well! I will be having a sale from Nov. 8th-Dec. 15th (and on Dec. 15th I will be closing my shop for good). Etsy I hope you learn from this mistake and think of the artists that use your platform first before making reckless decisions that are entirely working against artists.  • • #etsy #smallartist #etsyshop #etsyshopowner #shopsale
